terms.gloss: be brave! keep your spirits up!
terms.grammar: fac with the subjunctive (ut may be left out); animō fortī, ablative of quality
evidence: Cic. Fam. 1.5.6: tū fac animō fortī magnōque sīs (Lewis & Short), s.v. spērō
terms.comment: Cicero to a friend in trouble; the polite imperative fac (ut) with the subjunctive.

sources: Lewis & Short: fortis · Lewis & Short: animus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 101, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
